I skipped FS19, but played a lot of the previous games though. I'm really enjoying this one. You can tell they were mindful of some of the things players wanted in the game. I will say I had to look up some of the mechanics I wasn't familiar with because they were new or were in 19 and I just never knew about it. The ability to sleep and skip a day is really helpful when you're just starting out and don't want to grind forever on contract jobs. That being said, the contract jobs are better though as you can borrow equipment for them or use your own for max profit. You can technically play the game just doing nothing but that while buying your own equipment.

Overall, if you're a fan of the series definitely pick this one up!

Like every other FS game, they did even better than the last. No major bugs, no major problems if any with servers on GIANTS' end. I will unfortunately be leaving the game behind once they come out with a newer one for PC but these games are ALWAYS fun while they last. Many communities to connect to others that have common interests, many ways to play the game. And no certain way of playing the game is the right way. Only thing I would change about the game is the achievement system. They should tell you what you have to do to unlock achievements. Thank you again GIANTS for producing another amazing game.

I've played FS11 and FS15. I quit playing those because the only there was never any improvements on the physic model and the AI workers.

What has changed since? We got more vehicules, more crops, seasons (nice!) and production chains (from the farm to your table) but still the same physic model and the dumb AI workers. The physic model and AI have not evolve a single bit for the past 11 years! This game feels like a big FS11 DLC. But you can't charge 50-60$ for a DLC now. Can you?

I honestly feel like I've been ripped off. I'm done!

It's FS19 with improvements. Graphics have seen a slight face lift, but there are numerous little things that are a welcome surprise. Production chains are a nice addition (haven't messed with them a whole lot yet) and bring additional opportunities for income, at an additional price of course. This review was written with 188 total game play hours, 03/06/2022, looking forward to seeing the new mods and features in the coming months/year.

Pros:
-fun gameplay

Cons:
-bugs like broken trees that change visually to windows media player-screensavers if you cut them in certain angles.

-driving physics and handling is horrible in my opinion
-to me the trees are also awkward to do forestry with. Sometimes the physics go 404
-when holding pallets you can ascend to the skies when jumping
-AI drivers work mostly but aren't the most mentally gifted inviduals
-(this depends on opinion and preferences) the progression and making money is really slow, you can disregard this if you don't agree
-some variation in certain tools and vehicles would be great but this problem solves with mods eventually

If I could reverse time I would wait for sale and fixes

If you have ever owned any prior version of this game then don't waste your money on this. This game peaked around FS15 or FS17. These guys keep re-selling the exact same game over and over again at full price ever since FS13, each new version having VERY minor changes which are not worth the price. Worse is the cruft that should have been fixed long ago still lingering on from version to version. The main map of this game is full of bugs such as invisible artifacts that you run into which then havok your equipment. The food ratio calcuations for animal pens is still a huge mess and doesn't work properly, especially for pigs.
I love the concept of this game and I enjoy playing these type of tycoon games, but these guys need to ditch this tired old game engine, and stop with the minimal-effort new releases which they over-charge their customers for. Calling this a "simulator" with a straight face is more than a bit of a stretch, it is a tycoon game that needs a -serious- overhaul built with a modern game engine. This brand new game feels like it is 10+ years old.

I love the farm sim games, and each one for me has been a step up from the last. My biggest issue with 19 was that you couldn't do multiple contracts, and when the mod came out for that, I spent my life on it. 22 adds so many things to the game, and I love all of them. But my one con is that you can only have 3 contracts at a time, and in a season where I can't plant anything, I find myself sitting and waiting for those contracts to finish with nothing to do. If you do forestry or animals, I'm sure you'll be busy and love this. I love it! But I need to be able to do more than 3 contracts, whether it be through a mod, or a change in the game. If you're like me I recommend you wait, otherwise, buy it. It's so worth it.
